description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, styles, and the main App component, then initializes the React application by rendering App within the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node for rendering the React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the root DOM node.
